  subject,

    WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%parcel%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%order late%' THEN 'Shipping and delivery'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS theme
FROM workspace.exam_x79041.tickets
ORDER BY ticket_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x79041.ticket_themes AS
SELECT
  theme,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS INT) AS ticket_count,
  MIN(ticket_id) AS example_ticket_id
FROM (
  SELECT
    ticket_id,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%charge%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%refund%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%credit card%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%price%' THEN 'Billing'
      WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%log in%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%2fa%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%locked out%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%sso%' THEN 'Login and access'
      WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%parcel%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%order late%' THEN 'Shipping and delivery'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS theme
  FROM workspace.exam_x79041.tickets
)
WHERE theme IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY theme
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC
